content:
“Late Night” host Seth Meyers on Monday mocked Donald Trump’s new blame game claim, calling it a “whopper.”

Trump, while discussing Friday’s nationwide Federal Aviation Administration ground stop, the cause of which remains under investigation, declared: “I hate to blame anybody.”

Then, in the very next breath, he pointed the finger at the administration of former President Joe Biden, despite the agency’s infrastructure issues having developed over decades.

Meyers seized on the apparent contradiction.

“You guys, he hates to blame anybody,” he sarcastically said. “He hates it. That was so hard for him. He hates to blame anybody. He hates playing golf, and he hates yelling at reporters. He hates it.”
